newsitem.title: USA: U.S. equity fund flows slip for 2 days - survey.
newsitem.headline: U.S. equity fund flows slip for 2 days - survey.

text.p: Industrywide cash flows into U.S. mutual funds slipped to an estimated $2.80 billion for the two days ended May 5, compared to $2.95 billion for the three days ended May 1, according to a survey by Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.
Growth funds saw flows drop to $573 million from $912 million, while growth and income funds declined to $910 million from $915 million, the fund tracking firm reported.
Aggressive growth funds had inflows of $1.09 billion compared to $786 million.
International flows fell to $225 million compared to $2.29 billion.
Bond funds saw flows decline to $779 million from $1.81 billion.
Muni funds dropped to $126 million from $837 million, corporate/income/global funds declined to $391 million from $520 million.
High yield funds rose to $228 million from $204 million.
